c: On the incident, choose Sidebar discussions in the header; This record shows its discussions.
say: On the incident, choose the sidebar discussions icon in the header. This record shows the incident's discussions.

c: Choose + New discussion. The subject starts as the short description.
say: Choose new discussion. The subject starts as the incident's short description; change it if you like.

c: Add people or a group. Suggestions: the caller, the assignee, who is on call. Only people who can open the incident can read it.
say: Add people or a group. You are offered the caller, the assignee and who is on call. Only people who can open the incident can read the discussion.

c: Write a short message and choose Start discussion. Private can't be undone.
say: Write a short message and start the discussion. Make it private only if you must: that can't be undone.

c: Colleagues see it under Unread; a mention reaches their phone; the caller is emailed.
say: Colleagues see it under unread in their sidebar. A mention reaches their phone. The caller, if added, gets an email.

c: The side panel's Collaborate › Chat lists the same discussions; its + starts one.
say: The side panel's collaborate chat tab lists the same discussions, and its plus button starts one.
